### Borea v0.6.0-dev.6: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.6.0 before it is released.
It is not for users.
For normal use, stay on v0.5.2.
It builds on v0.6.0-dev.5, and the list below covers only what changed since that build.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- Sharing a vehicle when the list holds many vehicles.
  Go through Choose, Describe and Publish, and scroll each step to its end.
  Next, Back and Publish must always be in view, without a scroll to reach them.
- The License filter on the Mods and Vehicles tabs.
  Choose a group, then an exact license, and then only the exact license.
  The list must show only the entries that match, and the counts must agree with the list.
- Installs and updates of mods as before.
  Install a mod, update a mod, and remove a mod.
  All of them must work as on v0.6.0-dev.5.
- Going back: after you tested, read "Before you go back to v0.5.2" in the notes of v0.6.0-dev.2, and then start v0.5.2 again.
  Nothing new to know since that build.

#### New since v0.6.0-dev.5

- The share steps keep Back and Next in a bar that stays in view while the page scrolls.
  A long list of vehicles needs no scroll to reach Next.
  On Publish, the bar holds Publish with the public notice of the host right above it.
- When the forums thread of a listing or a pack is gone on three daily checks, Borea shows a warning and does not offer it for new installs.
  This applies to installs, updates, dependencies, packs and `borea://` install links.
  Copies that are already installed keep working.
- The License filter of Discover groups the licenses by what they allow: "Free, also for commercial use", "Not for commercial use" and "Other terms".
  Each group says which licenses it holds.
  The exact licenses stay in a box under the groups, and they narrow the chosen groups or filter on their own.
- An entry whose terms include a non-commercial part no longer shows under a free license.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.6.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
